messages:
Maya: Weekly health check for ZephyrHealth — quick snapshot across last 7d: usage +12% w/w, spend +8% (longer sequences), p50 latency 85ms -> 110ms, p95 420ms -> 610ms, error rate 0.6% -> 1.8% (5xx spike around 10:30 UTC on Wed). Model mix note: v2-small went to 30% traffic Tue; currently ~26% of requests. Fallbacks from v2->v1 at ~6.8% of v2 requests, mostly timeout/KV-cache-related.

Jonathan: thanks — do we have a breakdown of fallback reasons? timeout vs model-mismatch vs capacity?

Maya: quick breakdown from logs (sample):
```
2026-03-17T10:31:02Z v2-small req=abc123 fallback=timeout seq_len=2048 kv_cache_miss=1
2026-03-17T10:32:45Z v2-small req=def456 fallback=oom seq_len=4096 kv_cache_miss=0
```
Aggregate: ~58% timeout, 30% OOM/memory, 12% other (invalid weights/compat).

Luca: SRE here — we saw memory pressure on the shared dedicated pool at 10:30. Longer-history sessions triggered larger KV allocations. Patching a memory-compact kernel path to reduce per-request footprint; will canary in eng-runtime pool A.

Priya: from PM side, any evidence of quality regressions when falling back? Are customers noticing different behavior when they hit v1?

Maya: two CS tickets this week: one flagged slightly shorter completions after fallback, another reported minor formatting differences. No P0s. We captured request ids and surfaced to model-ops.

Aisha: CS enablement — I'll set up a short proactive email template and a webhook that pings account owners when fallback rate >5% for 24h. Also flag top 3 affected accounts for outreach.

Luca: deploy-bot kicked off canary for kernel tweak to 5 hosts (pool A) — monitor p95 and OOMs. If stable for 20m we'll roll to pool B.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started by @Luca to eng-runtime/pool-A at 1918123480.

Jonathan: finance check — spend uptick driven by longer seqs and fallback retries. If fallbacks persist, cost delta could hit +15% for this account monthly.

Maya: action items: (1) Luca — finish canary and share metrics (OOM, fallback %) by EOD; (2) Eng-runtime — add per-model-variant fallback metric (telemetry ticket created); (3) CS (Aisha/Maya) — outreach to top 3 accounts and send proactive note if fallback >5%; (4) PM (Priya) & Model-ops — review quality diffs on fallback responses. I'll reconvene next Wed for follow-up. :thumbsup:

Aisha: noted, will draft outreach and attach example request ids.

Priya: will sync with model-ops today to triage format/length diffs.

Maya: thanks all — I'll update this thread after canary results.
